body:
> **Decomposed 2026-09-01 into five children (A–E below).** This body is now the brief for the root's own
> attempt — the verify-and-synthesize pass that runs after every child has closed. The original design, and
> the eleven amendments that override it, are preserved under *Design record* at the bottom: they are what
> each child was given, and they are what you check the result against.

## Why

Five separate PRs built one feature: the pure report, the board read that feeds it, the CLI verb, the skill
procedure, and the packaging. Each was reviewed on its own. Nobody has yet checked that the pieces fit, and no
child could write the documentation that describes the whole.

## What

You are the root of a track. Your blockers' results arrive under **Parent task results**, but that is only the
leaf you are directly blocked by — so read the others yourself before you start:

```
hkb show 225     groomBoard + GROOM_KINDS and the pure helpers   (src/model.js)
hkb show 226     fetchBoard blockers:'all' + the doctor line      (src/tasks.js, src/doctor.js)
hkb show 227     the hkb groom verb                              (src/cli.js)
hkb show 228     /kanban:groom, the skill section and command     (SKILL.md, commands/groom.md)
hkb show 229     registration, docs and the wiki page
```

**Do not redo their work.** Your job is the seam and the story:

1. **Run it for real.** `hkb groom --json` and `hkb groom` against this board. Confirm one GraphQL call, zero
   writes, and that the human output is scannable. Check `hkb list` shows ` ⇡ unblocked`.
2. **Check the pieces actually agree.** `GROOM_KINDS` as exported vs the rows in the skill section; the frozen
   `--json` keys vs what the section tells a session to read; `GROOM_ACTIONS` vs the action column.
3. **Check the amendments survived.** Walk the eleven amendments below and confirm each landed. The ones most
   likely to have been lost across five PRs: no `detectCycles` (1), `no_goal` as `info` when a Done-when
   heading exists (2), `broad_path` present (3), guard-aware `overlap_pair.why` (4), `blocksIndex` computed
   over all tasks (9).
4. **Write what no child could**: the `docs/wiki/features/backlog-grooming.md` page as a whole-feature
   explanation rather than five partial ones, and a `docs/wiki/log.md` entry for the track.
5. **Report the gaps you did not fix** in your summary, as cards to file rather than silent edits.

## Done when

- [ ] `hkb groom` and `hkb groom --json` run against this board: one GraphQL call, zero writes, output scans.
- [ ] Every `GROOM_KINDS` kind and `GROOM_ACTIONS` value appears in the skill section, and the drift test passes.
- [ ] All eleven amendments are confirmed present, or the misses are named in the summary.
- [ ] `docs/wiki/features/backlog-grooming.md` describes the whole feature; `wiki-check.mjs` is clean for it.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test && npm run smoke` pass.

---

# Design record

*What follows is the original card, unchanged. The amendments at the top override the body wherever they differ.*

> Designed 2026-08-29 by a 10-agent evaluation (lane audit, mechanics audit, signal taxonomy → three designs → two judges → synthesis → adversarial critic). Both judges chose this design; the critic's verdict was **adopt with amendments** — the amendments below override the body where they differ.

## Amendments from the adversarial pass (apply over the body)

1. **Reuse, do not re-implement**: `unblocked` = `blockedBy.length >= 1 && computeReady(task, now)`; `two_agents` via `agentsOf`; `cycle` / `blocker_off_board` from the walk in `src/track.js` (import it, or lift it into model.js and have track.js call it). No new `detectCycles`.
2. **`no_goal` is `info` when the body has a Done-when heading** (act only when `specShape` finds neither) — on today's board 14/22 triage cards have `goal: null` and nine of them are promotable as written; fixture pinning #165 (goal null, Done-when present, blocker done) → promote.
3. **Add `broad_path` (ask)**: a path that is a directory prefix matching ≥ 3 other lane cards' paths (`test/` on six cards today); suggests narrowing.
4. **Overlap wording is guard-aware**: `overlap_pair.why` = "shares non-hub files with #b — a merge-conflict risk; serializes only when `dispatch.guards.path_overlap` is on"; pass the guard mode into `groomBoard` via opts (#185 turns it off by default on a manual board). Drop `one_slot` or key it on the same mode.
5. **The apply step executes only** `hkb comment` → `hkb create --triage --blocked-by` → `hkb link` → ONE `hkb promote --triage-only` (per-row yes). Archive/supersede rows and every kb-block edit are **handed back as pre-staged commands** until the prerequisite verbs exist (`hkb archive --superseded-by` strands children today; a raw kb PATCH is a by-hand rung).
6. **`hkb promote --triage-only`** (src/lifecycle.js `promote`): when set and `task.status !== 'triage'`, return `{ number, status, skipped: 'not in triage' }` without writing — today the `forced` stop fires after the label is already on the issue. **`hkb edit <n> --paths --goal --scheduled-at [--priority]`**: a thin verb over the kb block so specify/park rows have a verb. Both ship in this PR.
7. **Triage-only in v1**: drop the `blocked` lane from the skill (the CLI keeps `--status`); operate §4's "never promoting" clause becomes "except the rows of a /kanban:groom or /kanban:specify table the human has said yes to — the yes is what makes it theirs".
8. **`fetchBoard` `blockers: 'all'`** REST-fills only the lane cards today's fill skips (triage/ready), not every open card; the `⇡ unblocked` marker in `hkb list` is computed only when blockers were actually filled (`caps.blockedByGql` or a `blockersFilled` flag) — never a silent wrong answer.
9. **`blocksIndex` and mentions are computed over ALL tasks passed in**; `statuses` filters only which cards get a row (fixture: a running child of a triage blocker is listed under `blocks`).
10. **Pin the vocabulary the same way as the kinds**: export `GROOM_ACTIONS` from model.js; `test/skill.test.js` asserts every value appears in the section and no other action word appears in the table column — the drift-between-report-and-skill test.
11. **Dry-run corrections** (the design's own table, checked live): #116 is specify-then-promote with no link (the operator's comment says it is not blocked by #155); #117's evidence quotes headings the card does not have (they are "Gap 1 / Gap 2 / Done when"); #176/#185 are review-with-PR, not running.

---

## Why

Triage is where cards go to wait for a human's yes, and today nothing on the board tells the human what is waiting or why. Five triage cards (#114, #140, #141, #156, #165) have every blocker closed as completed and sit there anyway, because the tick's promote step (`src/dispatch.js:640`) only looks at `todo`; `hkb list`, `hkb doctor`, `hkb dispatch --dry-run` and the web board are all silent about it. Finding the rest by hand — cards with empty `kb.paths` (never guarded), no `kb.goal` (no acceptance section in the brief), a blocker still in triage, a priority inversion, a card that mentions another it should be linked to, two cards that will serialize on the same files — means reading 78 KB of `hkb list --status triage --json` (58 KB of it bodies) or running `hkb show` twenty-one times. CLAUDE.md calls a rung that is possible but tedious a bug. The judgment half (is this a duplicate, which way does the link go, is the decision made for the worker) needs a model, so it belongs in the skill like specify and decompose; the arithmetic half does not, and belongs in `src/model.js` where `blockerDone`, `computeReady`, `priorityOf` and `pathsOverlap` already live.

## What

Two things, one PR.

**1. `hkb groom` — a read verb.** One `fetchBoard(ctx, {includeClosed: !!flags.all, blockers: 'all'})` (new option in `src/tasks.js`: on a repo without the GraphQL `blockedBy` field fill blockers by REST for every open card, not only todo/blocked, and say so), then a pure `groomBoard(tasks, {now, caps, pairs = 10, statuses})` in `src/model.js`, added after `sortForDispatch`. Flags: `--status triage,todo,ready` (default: those three), `--all`, `--pairs N`, `--level act|ask|info`, `--bodies flagged|all|none` (default flagged), `--json`. Writes nothing.

Pure helpers, all unit-tested with fixture arrays and an injected clock: `blocksIndex(tasks)` (Map blocker → children), `ageDays(task, now)`, `specShape(bodyText)` (has `## Why` / `## What` / `## Done when`, length), `cardMentions(text, openNumbers)`, `pathHubs(tasks, share = 0.25)` (paths named by ≥ a quarter of open cards), `pathJaccard(a, b, hubs)` (normalised the way `pathsOverlap` normalises, prefix-aware, hubs removed), `detectCycles(tasks)`.

`GROOM_KINDS`, each finding `{kind, level: 'act'|'ask'|'info', evidence, suggests}`:
- `unblocked` — act. status triage ∧ `blockedBy.length ≥ 1` ∧ every `blockerDone` ∧ `scheduled_at` not in the future. The ≥1 rule is the definition: without it 13 of 21 triage cards match and the finding means nothing. `scheduled_at` in the future is the park lever, no new field.
- `no_blockers` — info. `dead_blocker` (a NOT_PLANNED/DUPLICATE blocker: can never be ready) — ask. `blocker_in_triage` (an open blocker whose own status is triage) — ask. `priority_inversion` (an open blocker with lower `priorityOf`; higher wins) — ask.
- `no_paths`, `no_goal`, `malformed_kb` — act, suggests `/kanban:specify`. `thin_spec` (a missing heading or body < 400 chars) — ask, never act: a good spec under other headings is a false hit.
- `merged_pr_open` (state OPEN ∧ `prs.some(merged)`, prints `baseRefName`) — ask; suggests 'verify the base branch', never close.
- `cycle`, `two_agents`, `blocker_off_board` — act with doctor-style fix text (`hkb unlink`, `hkb adopt --agent`).
- `unknown_blockers` — info, when `caps.blockedByGql` is false and blockers were not filled; an empty list on such a repo is never reported as `no_blockers`.
- Shortlists for the model, never verdicts: `mentions_unlinked` (`#n` in bodyText+goal ∩ open numbers − blockedBy − blocks) and `overlap_pair` (Jaccard ≥ 0.4 after hubs, top-k, phrased 'will serialize under path_overlap').

`proposeAction(card)` → one of the closed vocabulary `promote · specify · link-under · split · supersede · reprioritise · park · archive`, or `judge` when a shortlist finding exists, or `none`. `needs_judgment` is true for any shortlist finding.

`--json` shape (stable, keys asserted): `{board, read_at, cards_read, blockers_source: 'graphql'|'rest', summary: {by_status, hubs, one_slot}, cards: [{number, title, status, agent, priority, age_days, touched_days, paths, goal, blocked_by, blocks, findings, proposal, needs_judgment, bodyText?}], pairs: [{a, b, score, shared, why}], judgment: {cards, pairs}}`. `bodyText` is present only when `needs_judgment` (or `--bodies all`); a test asserts unflagged cards carry none — that is the whole token argument (today: ~10 KB report + ~28 KB of flagged bodies instead of 78 KB).

Human output: a header (`26 open · 21 triage · hubs: src/model.js (12), …`), one row per card in `taskLine` style ending in `⇒ <proposal>` and the evidence, a `pairs` block, a footer counting act/ask/info. `taskLine` itself gains ` ⇡ unblocked` computed in memory so `hkb list` shows the nudge with no new field and no write. Unknown `--level`/`--bodies` values exit 2 naming the list.

Not in this card (deferred, each measured noisy today): `stale`/`--older-than`, `decision_open`, `too_big`, `--comments`, web-board chips (`src/serve.js` stays untouched), `promote --ready`, bulk `link`, `archive --superseded-by`, `hkb edit`.

**2. `/kanban:groom [status]` — the procedure, in `skills/kanban/SKILL.md`.** A `## /kanban:groom` section between `/kanban:decompose` and `## Rules`, and `commands/groom.md` in the exact shape of `specify.md` (frontmatter, the section name, both SKILL.md locations, two invariants restated: one report read then the whole table and a stop for a yes before any verb; archive, close-as-duplicate, unlink and priority are never in the batch). The section: (0) seat check; (1) read ONCE — `hkb groom --json` and `hkb dispatch --dry-run`; never `hkb list --json`, never a `hkb show` loop, never a pasted inventory; (2) a findings table with one row per `GROOM_KINDS` kind (kind · prints as · what you do · what a false positive looks like); (3) judge only `judgment.cards` and `pairs` with one fixed question per kind; (4) one table grouped by cluster — card · action · target · evidence · exact command — then STOP; (5) apply approved rows in this order: `hkb comment` → `hkb create --triage --blocked-by <revealer>` (never `--priority`) → `hkb link` → kb PATCH via the specify recipe then `hkb show --json` for `_malformed` → ONE `hkb promote a b c` of triage-only cards, a `forced` line in the output is a stop-and-report → `hkb archive` last, one at a time, after a `Superseded by #m` comment and after re-linking its `blocks[]` children to the survivor (reversal: reopen + `hkb adopt <n> --status triage`); (6) verify with `hkb groom`, `hkb graph`, `hkb dispatch --dry-run`; (7) digest in operate §5 shape, stating that promoted N is a queue, not N running. Operate §3: the `appeared` row and the `triage` status row become 'run the /kanban:groom per-card pass (`hkb groom --json --status triage`) and propose — never promote'; §4 lists `hkb groom` among the reads that are yours. Frontmatter `description` names the command; `metadata.version` 0.6.0 → 0.7.0.

**Registration and docs.** `test/init.test.js:306` file list and `:315` `commandNames()` gain `groom`; `test/skill.test.js:184` doctor string becomes `/kanban:decompose, /kanban:groom, /kanban:operate, /kanban:specify not registered — the skill documents them`; `scripts/smoke-pack.mjs` MUST_SHIP (`commands/groom.md`) and FROM_PACKAGE (`.claude/commands/kanban/groom.md`). `src/doctor.js` next to the `GraphQL Issue.blockedBy` line at :1019: when the field is absent, warn that `hkb groom` fills blockers with one REST call per open card. README planning table gets a third row and `hkb groom` joins the snippet beside `hkb dispatch --dry-run`; `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` description names four commands; cli HELP; new wiki page `docs/wiki/features/backlog-grooming.md` from `_templates/page.md`, `planning-commands.md` re-stamped, `index.md`, `log.md`; one sentence in `protocol.md` under the tick: `hkb groom` is a read like `dispatch --dry-run` — no status, label or transition changes.

## Done when

- [ ] `hkb groom --json` on the fake-gh double makes exactly one GraphQL call and zero writes; `hkb groom` prints one line per card; `--level x` exits 2 naming the list.
- [ ] `test/groom.test.js` has one fixture case per `GROOM_KINDS` kind, including: the five live `unblocked` cases and a zero-blocker triage card that must NOT match; a NOT_PLANNED blocker → `dead_blocker`, never `unblocked`; `caps.blockedByGql = false` + empty list → `unknown_blockers`; hub removal at 25% on a fixture from today's board; mentions minus blockers minus children; `proposeAction` table; JSON key stability; no `bodyText` on unflagged cards.
- [ ] `hkb list` shows ` ⇡ unblocked` on a triage card whose ≥1 blockers are all done, computed in memory.
- [ ] `test/skill.test.js`: the groom section has a row for every `GROOM_KINDS` kind; it names `hkb groom --json`, 'stop for a yes', `--triage` and `forced`; every `hkb <verb>` it invokes is a `case '<verb>'` in `src/cli.js`; it never says `hkb dispatch` without `--dry-run` and never `--loop`.
- [ ] `test/init.test.js` and the doctor 'not registered' string list four commands; `scripts/smoke-pack.mjs` ships and installs `groom.md`.
- [ ] Operate §3 `appeared`/`triage` rows and §4 updated; `metadata.version` bumped; README, plugin.json, HELP, protocol.md sentence, wiki page + re-stamps in place; `node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` clean.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test && npm run smoke` pass.
- [ ] `src/dispatch.js` is unchanged by this PR (grep: the promote step still filters `status === 'todo'`).

## Contract

- `groomBoard(tasks, {now, caps, pairs, statuses})` and `GROOM_KINDS` are exported from `src/model.js`; a later card puts the same function behind `hkb serve`'s snapshot for chips, so it must take the raw `fetchBoard` array and nothing else.
- `fetchBoard(ctx, {blockers: 'all'})` is the only I/O change; `'all'` means REST-fill every open card on a repo without GraphQL blockedBy, and `true` keeps today's todo/blocked-only behaviour.
- `--json` field names above are frozen; later kinds are added to `findings`, never renamed.
- The CLI never emits the word 'duplicate' as a finding; `overlap_pair.why` is 'will serialize under path_overlap'.
- `commands/groom.md` restates at most the two invariants; the procedure lives only in SKILL.md.
- Land after #185 (running now) and before #165 C / #117 reopen the SKILL.md tables, or accept a rebase: `src/model.js` and `skills/kanban/SKILL.md` are hub paths.

<!-- proposed kb for `hkb create`: --priority 4 --paths src/model.js,src/cli.js,src/tasks.js,src/doctor.js,skills/kanban/SKILL.md,commands/groom.md,test/groom.test.js,test/cli.test.js,test/init.test.js,test/skill.test.js,scripts/smoke-pack.mjs,README.md,.claude-plugin/plugin.json,docs/wiki/,skills/kanban/references/protocol.md --goal "hkb groom --json reports every LLM-free triage finding from one board read with zero writes, and /kanban:groom judges only what it flags, proposes one table, and stops for a yes" --triage -->

Title: `hkb groom + /kanban:groom: one-read lane report, judged in the skill, promoted only by a human`
goal: One command turns the triage lane into a proposal table — unblocked, thin spec, overlap, mentions — computed without an LLM from the board read hkb list already makes; the skill judges only the flagged cards and applies comment/create/link/one promote after the human says yes per row
title: hkb groom: a read-only lane report from the one board read, and /kanban:groom that judges only what it flags and applies nothing without a yes
